zmiany: Auto: captions already on the timeline open as they are — change one and click Update caption to replace just that caption
Titles with In/Out: click a style to lay out the marked words in it — as one caption or word by word
Layouts: drag words between lines, ⇧-drag to move a row left or right, ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z undo
Captions end exactly when the last word is spoken; same height in the frame for every style
Words per slide: More now really makes longer captions
Convert Captions: works on the In/Out range and can take the look from a style
Spacing between words matches each font, also with tracking
